title: The Forbidden Primer of Hunger
summary: A guarded primer that teaches a new soul cultivator to draw a thread of soul force from another and to shield the soul from the same draw.

title: A Hidden Handbook of Draining
summary: A hidden handbook of small drains and sips of soul force that a beginner can practice without harm to the target's whole soul.

title: Notes on the Tithe of the Soul
summary: Plain notes on taking a measured tithe from a foe's soul in a fight and on reading what the tithe has left behind.

title: The Early Awakener's Hunger
summary: A rare basic text for a Monarch whose soul woke early and now feels the first hunger of the devouring art.
